name: Elvis Presley
hook: The King: Memphis, Graceland, the movies and the manager — a handful of facts cover most Elvis clues.

facts.label: Memphis
facts.statement: Elvis Presley was born in Tupelo, Mississippi, in 1935 and became the King of Rock 'n' Roll in Memphis.

facts.label: Graceland
facts.statement: Graceland is his Memphis mansion; fans gather there for his January 8 birthday and Elvis Week.

facts.label: "Heartbreak Hotel"
facts.statement: "Heartbreak Hotel," his 1956 hit, is about a place to dwell; Whitney Houston later recorded a different song with that title.

facts.label: "Hound Dog"
facts.statement: "Hound Dog" was the flipside of "Don't Be Cruel"; he sang it to a basset hound named Sherlock on The Steve Allen Show.

facts.label: his 31 movies
facts.statement: He made 31 features, including Love Me Tender, Jailhouse Rock, Blue Hawaii and Viva Las Vegas; the Blue Hawaii soundtrack hit No. 1.

facts.label: Colonel Tom Parker
facts.statement: Colonel Tom Parker managed him — an illegal Dutch immigrant who had once been a Tampa dogcatcher.
